components.name: HdrHistogram
components.description: HdrHistogram supports the recording and analyzing sampled data value counts across a configurable integer value range with configurable value precision within the range. Value precision is expressed as the number of significant digits in the value recording, and provides control over value quantization behavior across the value range and the subsequent value resolution at any given level.

components.name: configd-linz
components.description: A3 linearizability + fault-injection harness (R-04). Drives a REAL separate-JVM Configd cluster (the shaded configd-server jar) over the REAL TcpRaftTransport, under OS-level faults (iptables / tc / kill -9), records a checker-neutral op-history, and verifies it with a TRUSTED third-party checker (Porcupine). This deliberately does NOT use the in-process SimulatedNetwork — that is the path that hid R-01. The harness treats the server as a black box (HTTP + process control), so it depends on no other io.configd module at compile time.
